question: Who was the first Indian to receive the medal and Diploma of the French association Archives Internationales de la Danse?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mrinalini Sarabhai.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The first Indian to receive the medal and Diploma of the French association Archives Internationales de la Danse was Mrinalini Sarabhai.**
 
• She was a renowned classical dancer and choreographer from Gujarat.
 
• Sarabhai was the founder of the** Darpana Academy of Performing Arts in Ahmedabad**, which is a leading institution for the performing arts in India.
 
• She was also a recipient of several other prestigious awards, including the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Amala Akkineni, is also a well-known actress and classical dancer, but she has not received this particular award.
 
• Jatin Goswami, is a noted Sattriya dancer from Assam,.
 
• Alarmel Valli, is a prominent Bharatanatyam dancer from Tamil Nadu, but neither of them has received this award.
